cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.
